## What

One change, described in a couple of sentences.

## Why

The problem this removes, or the check this adds. Link an issue if there is one.

## How it was verified
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make type`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make cov` (85% floor)
- [ ] Manual check (describe what you ran and what you saw)

## What could go wrong

The first failure mode of this change and what would notice it. If the answer is "a rule
stops matching", say which test catches that.

## AI assistance
- Tool used:
- What the assistant produced:
- What I changed or rejected, and why:

## A note for the reviewer

Keep it under ~400 changed lines. If it is bigger, split it.
